title: multi run --replay runs every scenario with scripted agents and no model call
goal: multi run SCENARIO --replay starts, in place of claude, _tools/bench_replay.py as each agent's scripted stand-in, which makes no model call, prints one stream-json result event with planted usage and records the commands it ran as the line's steps; a replayed lookup agent runs rag.py pack on its questions; a replayed research agent runs coord.py dedup on its area and commits one planted fact to its clone, synced to the sandbox bare; a replayed code agent is dispatched on its sandbox item, commits its planted change and is landed by the harness; a replay of every scenario, at once and with --sequential, ends with a line per agent with no failure, every code item and research commit on the sandbox bare's main and this clone's HEAD and origin/main unmoved

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1200):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-600:], r.stderr[-600:])
    return r

import json
want = {"lookup": "rag.py pack", "research": "coord.py dedup"}
for s in ("lookups", "research", "mixed"):
    for seq in ([], ["--sequential"]):
        d = os.path.join(T, s + ("-seq" if seq else ""))
        bench("multi", "run", s, "--replay", "--dir", d, *seq)
        L = [json.loads(x) for x in open(os.path.join(d, "results.jsonl"), encoding="utf-8") if x.strip()]
        assert L and all(not x.get("failure") for x in L), (s, seq, L[:2])
        assert all(x["input_tokens"] > 0 and x["wall_s"] > 0 for x in L), (s, seq, L[:2])
        for x in L:
            w = want.get(x["role"])
            assert w is None or any(w in step for step in x["steps"]), (s, x["role"], x.get("steps"))
assert not os.path.exists(MARK), "a replay started claude"

    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-600:], r.stderr[-600:])
    return r

import json
git = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
before = (git("rev-parse", "HEAD"), git("rev-parse", "refs/remotes/origin/main"))
d = os.path.join(T, "m")
bench("multi", "run", "mixed", "--replay", "--dir", d)
L = [json.loads(x) for x in open(os.path.join(d, "results.jsonl"), encoding="utf-8") if x.strip()]
bare = os.path.join(d, "origin.git")
log = git("--git-dir", bare, "log", "main", "--format=%H %B")
code = [x for x in L if x["role"] == "code"]
assert len(code) == 2 and all(x["land"] == "ok" and x["item"] in log for x in code), code
res = [x for x in L if x["role"] == "research"]
assert len(res) == 2 and all(x["commit"] and x["commit"] in log for x in res), res
assert (git("rev-parse", "HEAD"), git("rev-parse", "refs/remotes/origin/main")) == before, "the replay moved this clone"
